title: Wardenclyffe Tower
geometryBasis: Independent story identity Q2164598, the native foundation outline and the June 1904 published photograph agree on the location and eight-sided form. The caption provides exact design height, base and crown dimensions.
sectionBasis: The primary June 4, 1904 periodical photograph records the actual exposed timber and crown ribs. The caption measures 187 feet to the top, 154 feet to the structural head, 96 feet minimum across the base and 65 feet diameter at the cupola.
limitations: Shows the 1904 archival appearance and remains hidden in the modern view. Subsurface works, the contiguous industrial grounds and the adjacent lab are outside the model.
The historic open timber frame and cupola use the documented dimensions. Individual interior braces, fasteners and timbers omitted behind the published view are representative.
The current independent survey supplies geographic terrain. Fine grade around the tower in 1904 is estimated.
